integrity: The super-dominating complement criterion is reconstructed directly from the definition and agrees with the published all-set classification. The coalition-partition theorem is proved independently, and the explicit universal-vertex counterexample is checked both symbolically and by exhaustive enumeration.
scientific_limitations: The theorem is restricted to connected complete multipartite graphs. Exhaustive verification reaches order \(8\) and is corroborative only; arbitrary order rests on the symbolic proof. A residual literature risk remains for poorly indexed equivalent coalition terminology, and later revisions of the initiating preprint may change its universal-vertex statement.
title: Super coalition numbers of complete multipartite graphs
